articles.title: Kensing Unveils Its First Fully Upcycled Biosurfactant Platform for Personal and Home Care applications
articles.mainIdea: Kensing Unveils Its First Fully Upcycled Biosurfactant Platform for Personal and Home Care applications
articles.summary: PR Newswire: Kensing Unveils Its First Fully Upcycled Biosurfactant Platform for Personal and Home Care applications. Following its strategic partnership with AmphiStar Biosurfactants, Kensing, LLC unveils Regenyl™ and Revolis™, its first fully upcycled, low-carbon, and palm-free biosurfactants in North America. Kensing will showcase Regenyl™ at NYSCC Suppliers' Day, May 19–20, Booth #1913.

articles.title: Teva Delivers Strong Q1 2026 Results Driven by Innovative Portfolio Growth and Disciplined Execution
articles.mainIdea: Teva Delivers Strong Q1 2026 Results Driven by Innovative Portfolio Growth and Disciplined Execution
articles.summary: GlobeNewswire: Teva Delivers Strong Q1 2026 Results Driven by Innovative Portfolio Growth and Disciplined Execution. For an accessible version of this Press Release, please visit www.tevapharm.com Q1 2026 revenues of ~$4.0 billion increased by 2% in U.S. dollars year-over-year (YoY), and decreased by 3% in local currency terms (LC). Excluding the Japan business venture (BV) results, revenues decreased by 1% in LC. These strong first quarter results were driven by our innovative portfolio growth and disciplined execution, even with lower revenues from lenalidomide capsules (the generic version of Revlimid®) due Related tickers mentioned: TEVA.
